title: D-024 Amendment 43: dedicated read-only canary-execution vehicle (R587-R589 live canary; task_authority fixture)
objective: Serve as the claimed, runnable canary-execution task the M0-T136 ten-item live canary package binds to (probe_task_authority requires a packet+ledger status in {claimed,in_progress,awaiting_gate}; accepted M0-T136 confers no working authority). Read-only execution vehicle: the owner-typed canary script drafts the launch manifest against this packet and runs canary-b5-01 (intended launch_manifest_mismatch/clean_status refusal) and the single accepted canary-b5-02 supervised one-shot. Task stays claimed until the live canary finishes (D-024-R651). No production code is changed under this task.
business_reason: Owner directive 2026-09-02 (D-024 Amendment 43, R644-R663): the live canary stopped safely on task_authority; a dedicated minimal canary-execution task is the authorized correction.
